observation: The locked plan's explicit discovered-model contract made it straightforward to reject MODEL_CATALOG fallbacks and prove opencode model discovery with a real harness-facing integration test.
Unit tests passed while agent row names were visually crowded out in the split-pane origin; Playwright paint against the real Settings surface caught the defect before ship.

Several broad AppShell tests use under-shaped global fetch mocks, causing SettingsOrgChart runtime errors on stderr even when assertions pass; this makes real regressions harder to spot in full test output.
